limitations: Diversity selection uses only the recorded score (J); geometric descriptors are not in the catalog and would improve basin detection.
Round-trip kind 'hash_identity' confirms the catalog row's own design_hash is non-empty hex; it does NOT re-derive the geometry from knob values (needs_config=True for all designs).

Full geometric round-trip (calling GeneratedSpace.to_design and comparing the resulting hash) requires loading the typology config and is not performed here.  Run the round-trip check with the config's search module for each selected design before use.
Screen-only designs are labelled; prefer matched verify data when available.
